profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello! 👋🏼  My name is Sue Ann and I'm a full stack software engineer with a passion for developing performant and delightful web applications. I am people-focused and believe in user-centric design. I particularly love building products that provide a seamless experience. I am always excited to explore new technologies!


Front End:   JavaScript, Next.js, Typescript, React, Svelte, Webpack, Rollup, HTML/CSS
Back End:  Node.js, Express, MySQL/PostgreSQL, GraphQL, MongoDB
Tools & Testing:  GIT, Jira, Mocha/Chai, Jest

Familiar with: Rust, Docker, AWS, Nginx

company.name: Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Built front end features (pop-ups, scrollview, tooltip) for the NNS (Network Nervous System) governance dashboard, and improved accessibility according to WCAG 2.1 compliance.
•  Worked on the SDK team to improve JavaScript tooling and documentation (agent-js).
• Worked with documentation and languages team to build from start to finish a custom syntax highlighter plugin for Dfinity’s  public website.
positions.insights: Skills: Webpack · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · Git · lit-html · React.js · Front-End Development · Software Documentation · SASS · Svelte · TypeScript

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
•  Worked on mobile-first design for web apps and mobile app development for iOS.
•  React, HTML5, React Native, Expo, Python, Selenium WebDriver.
positions.insights: Skills: Webpack · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Front-End Development · Selenium WebDriver · Python (Programming Language) · HTML5 · React Native

positions.title: NNS Shopping Site
positions.description:
• Built reusable responsive products microservice, with custom-built image gallery and thumbnail slider.
• Set up ETL from CSV to Postgres for approximately 2 million+ entries.
• Scaled service to handle up to 5,000 RPS via elastic load balancer across EC2 instances.
• Decreased response time from 6s to 63ms with Postgres b-tree indexing.

https://github.com/wackyleo459/Front-End-Capstone

positions.title: Groupster | Group chat platform for learners
positions.description:
• Owned overall UI, creating a design system with wireframes for other engineers to follow.
• Built modular design components with Material UI and custom CSS for a clean responsive interface.
• Used GraphQL to standardize endpoints for passing data to frontend and storing in React state.
• Worked in an agile environment with 3 engineers, troubleshooting & identifying bottleneck problems.

https://github.com/h2Ocean/Groupster

educations.fieldOfStudy: Fullstack Development immersive program with 1000+ hrs of coding

projects.title: React Native Starter for the Internet Computer
projects.description:
• Created an example React Native starter app with tutorial usage for simple startup workflow using Metro server that securely communicates with a deployed app on the Internet Computer blockchain.
• Identified pain points for React Native development and improved agent-js library package.

projects.title: Groupster: Group chat platform for learners
projects.description:
• Owned overall UI, creating a design system with wireframes. Worked in an agile environment with 3 other engineers, troubleshooting, identifying any merge issues or other bottleneck problems.
• Built modular design system components with Material UI and custom CSS for a clean responsive interface.
• Used GraphQL to standardize endpoints for passing data to frontend and storing in React state.
